title: Assign Row Numbers to Ordered Rows
learning_objective: Learn how ROW_NUMBER creates a sequence based on sort order.

tutorial.explanation: ROW_NUMBER gives each row a position after sorting. This is the foundation of many consecutive-row tricks.
tutorial.syntax: SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id) AS rn FROM stadium;
tutorial.mental_model: The original id can have gaps. ROW_NUMBER creates a clean 1, 2, 3 sequence over the rows you kept.

guided_example.prompt: Assign row numbers ordered by id.
guided_example.solution_query: SELECT id, visit_date, people, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id) AS rn FROM stadium;
guided_example.explanation: ROW_NUMBER follows the id order and gives each row a new sequence number.

practice.prompt: Return id and rn for rows ordered by visit_date.
practice.expected_query: SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY visit_date) AS rn FROM stadium;

hints: Put ORDER BY visit_date inside OVER.
Alias the window value as rn.
